column3: Kuroneko Route · Late-night Lovers' Talk
Do you wish to do some nice things with me?
...And what if I said I did?
...People like you are truly... fools beyond redemption.
Isn't this a dream? In that case there's nothing wrong with being honest about one's desires. Right?
...Could it be that senpai wanted to do lewd things with me since long ago?
Well, if you put it that way.. Err... You know...
I can't say that I find her strangely attractive right now...!
A fool... I guess you could say that.
But aren't you the one seducing me?
Hmph... Such banal words.
Sorry, I couldn't think of anything else.
Well then, are we going to do something good together?
Fufufu... What should I do, I wonder.
Eh, are you trying to tease me?! There are good times and bad times when it comes to teasing men!
Things like that don't concern me. I just wanted to toy with you.
T-Toy... with me...?!
She's treating me like a complete idiot and yet...!
Why is my heart beating so fast?!
Are you hesitating? Well, it certainly doesn't fit your character, even if this is just a dream.
...I could do it if I felt like it.
Oh really...? But for someone like you who doesn't know how to handle men, I doubt you'd be able to.
Surely you jest. You need only abandon your body to me.
Uooohhh! Is this... really happening?!
Hmm... Haa... Fufu...
*GULP*
Well then... lie there just like that... and relax your body.
For real...? *gulp*
Getting second thoughts now? What a weakling.
...Should I stop?
No! By all means!
Fufufu, close your eyes.
Ah...*gulp*. Ah, since this is my first time, please be gentle...
...I know.
Then, close your eyes...
Close your eyes obediently, good boy. Now then, this...
Eh?
Fufufu.
K-Kuroneko? What was that sound just now?
It'll be fine, I'll make you feel relaxed.
Not that! My nervousness is already coming apart!
...Liar. Everything has been a lie.
What!?
Something like this was enough to tempt you.
Did you really think you had the qualifications?
Eh? Eh? W-What are you talking about?
Do you really think that a loser like you can get in the way of my goals?
Hey, hold it! This is getting too real for a dream!
Hehe, all right, in accordance to the previous prophecy, I'll carve the punishment into your body.
Eh? Hold it, how can this be! What's that on your hand!? N-No! It's too big! Stop! AAAAAAAAHHH!
A-A dream... huh...
Man, she's even appearing in my dreams... Phew.
I'll go crazy if I don't resolve this quickly...
